title: Cloud channels weekly — prep & follow-ups (scratch)
content:
Context / purpose:
- Quick scratchpad for the weekly cloud channels sync (30m) with partner ops leads.
- Goal: unblock listings + billing issues, confirm next-week integration tests, align on Gov/region asks.

Meeting logistics:
- Recurring: Tue 10:00am PT, 30m.
- Attendees (usually): AWS marketplace ops (Teresa), Azure marketplace PM (Ravi), GCP partner lead (Linh), Redwood bizdev (Aisha), me (Jules)
- This week: focused on 3 urgent items + org updates.

Draft agenda (tight):
1) 3 quick wins (5m): recent fixes we pushed (pricing config, test harness).
2) Listing statuses (8m): AWS: approval stuck; Azure: docs updated; GCP: needs e2e cert.
3) Billing reconciliation (7m): credit application for early pilot customers.
4) Region/Gov ask (5m): customer wants GovCloud + private deployment support.
5) Action review + owners (5m).

Prep notes (things to bring up / questions):
- AWS approval stuck since last Friday. Teresa said listing flagged for metadata. Need exact field names. TODO: ask Teresa for the metadata field list (owner: Teresa, due: Wed).
- Billing: pilot customer "FinData" was charged twice for embeddings > reachback. Check invoice IDs (see JIRA-1342). I should pull invoice PDF before call.
- GCP: Linh mentioned terraform module failure in e2e (timeout on granting service account roles). Quick ask: can partner grant me test project for 48h to reproduce? If not, request logs.
- Azure: their listing page requires updated privacy statement. Draft text in GH PR #87 — ask Ravi to confirm acceptance.
- Metrics ask: partners want token-level cost estimate per inference to show to customers. We should present a one-liner: "~$0.0004 per token for 8k context with batching" but mark as approximate. (Action: Ops team to produce official table).

Notes for my quick talking points (sounding board):
- "We shipped a small fix to pricing config last night; should clear 2 listings we saw blocked"
- "For the billing duplicate, we will open a reconciliation ticket and refund if needed; need invoice ID and customer consent."
- "Gov/Reg: we can support VPC/private plane but need to scope network setup + SSO. Let's set a follow-up runbook session with Eng next week"

Immediate follow-ups to assign in meeting (template):
- Who: Teresa (AWS ops) | What: send exact metadata field names blocking approval | Due: Wed 2026-03-11 | Notes: prefer inline CSV
- Who: Jules (me) | What: pull invoice PDFs & attach to JIRA-1342 | Due: Wed 2026-03-11 | Notes: include refund recommendation
- Who: Linh (GCP) | What: provide e2e terraform logs or grant 48h test project | Due: Thu 2026-03-12 | Notes: if grant denied, ask for service-account logs
- Who: Ravi (Azure) | What: confirm privacy statement text in PR #87 | Due: Tue 2026-03-10 (ASAP) | Notes: we can accept small tweak
- Who: Eng-Platform (Aisha to loop) | What: prepare simple token-cost table for partners | Due: Fri 2026-03-13 | Notes: include 3 example profiles (low/med/high concurrency)

Backlog / longer-term asks (bring up if time):
- Standardize marketplace onboarding checklist (single doc). Owner: Aisha? put under Confluence.
- Automation: publish a status webhook to partners for listing progression.
- Pilot refund SLA for marketplace billing disputes.

Scratch / to-self items (notes after meeting):
- Check whether refund needs finance approval > $2k (ping finance).
- Remind SRE to document region-specific firewall rules for GovCloud setups.
- Follow up with Solutions Eng for a demo environment for Marketplace listing screenshots (they need env with demo tenant).

Conversation bits I want to capture during call (quick shorthand):
- "metadata-reqs" = exact JSON schema they need for listing (ask Teresa).
- "invoice dup" = invoice duplication case id, note customer contact.
- "e2e-grant" = whether partner can grant test project.

Post-meeting quick checklist (to run right after call):
- Send meeting notes and action list to attendees + link to this doc.
- Create/annotate JIRA tasks for each action, tag owners.
- Upload invoice PDFs to JIRA-1342 and notify finance.
- If Gov ask accepted, schedule 60m follow-up with Platform Eng + Security.

Other links to have handy in meeting:
- Confluence: marketplace-onboarding-notes (link above).
- JIRA-1342 (billing duplication).
- GH PR: marketplace-scripts PR #87 (privacy text).
- Slack thread: marketplace-ops (search keyword "marketplace ops - approvals").

Personal notes / coach-yourself lines (keep short):
- Start with wins — makes partners receptive.
- Avoid over-promising on timelines; use "target" language.
- Call out blockers clearly and list immediate owner for unblock.

End of scratchpad.

-- Jules
